<li>CENTER_EGRESS_3: Center Exit 3

Default value: CENTER_EGRESS_1.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>

<ul>
<li>BANDWIDTH_PACKAGE: Payment for Shared Bandwidth Package</li>
<li>TRAFFIC_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR: Traffic is paid by the hour
Default value: TRAFFIC_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Elastic IPv6 bandwidth limit in Mbps.
The range of selectable values depends on the EIP billing method:</p>
<ul>
<li>BANDWIDTH_PACKAGE: 1 Mbps to 2000 Mbps</li>
<li>TRAFFIC_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR: 1 Mbps to 100 Mbps
Default value: 1 Mbps.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="internetserviceprovider_csharp">

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>

<li>CUCC: China Unicom

</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

## Import



vpc elasticPublicIpv6 can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Elastic/publicIpv6:PublicIpv6 elastic_public_ipv6 elastic_public_ipv6_id
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
